blocks.text: This article provides information for managing Zscaler Digital Experience (ZDX) Administration using APIs. All APIs are rate limited. To learn more, see Understanding Rate Limiting.
To get the details of all the configured departments, send a GET request to the endpoint /administration/departments. Provide the following in the request:

blocks.item: from: The timestamp, in epoch, from when the data is displayed.
to: The timestamp, in epoch, till when the data is displayed.

blocks.text: The request body can also include the search attribute to get the data for a specific department ID or name.
A successful response returns code 200. To learn more, see Understanding Error Codes.
To get the details of all the configured Zscaler locations, send a GET request to the endpoint /administration/locations. Provide the following in the request:

blocks.item: from: The timestamp, in epoch, from when the data is displayed.
to: The timestamp, in epoch, till when the data is displayed.

blocks.text: The request body can also include the search attribute to get the data for a specific location ID or name.
A successful response returns code 200. To learn more, see Understanding Error Codes.
